drivingQuestion: Why does bran not combine for carrying out when it combines for halla?

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ וְסוּבָּן וּמוּרְסָנָן לֹא מִצְטָרְפִין? וְהָתְנַן: חֲמֵשֶׁת רְבָעִים קֶמַח וְעוֹד, חַיָּיבִין בַּחַלָּה הֵן וְסוּבָּן וּמוּרְסָנָן! אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: שֶׁכֵּן עָנִי אוֹכֵל פִּתּוֹ בְּעִיסָּה בְּלוּסָה.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: «And do the bran and coarse bran» of cereals «not join together? Didn’t we learn» in a mishna: Dough made from «five-quarters» of a log of «flour and» a bit «more obligates» one to separate «ḥalla?» That amount includes «them,» the flour, «and their bran, and their coarse bran.» Apparently, bran and coarse bran join together with the flour to constitute the requisite measure. «Abaye said:» Bran joins together with the flour with regard to ḥalla and the making of bread, «since a pauper eats his loaf» made «from dough mixed with bran.» However, with regard to carrying out on Shabbat, the food items in question must be suitable for all people, since the measures are small and are calculated by their significance.
